title: VerificationRunStatus
description:
`GET /v1/verification/runs/{run_id}` response.

Execution state and pointers only: the verdict and Drift/Eval details are read from Bifrost by `result_id`. A run may point at an acknowledged result before it is visible to analytical queries.

dispatches.description: Every Operator dispatch of a failed binding-created run, in identity order; empty otherwise.

error.description: Last execution error of a retrying or terminal run.

requested_by_principal_id.description: Authenticated caller of a manual run; null for scheduled and observation-created runs.

result_id.description: Canonical result of a completed run.

FrozenTarget.description:
A frozen reference to one effective Trigger or Operator.

A referenced Card is frozen by its exact UID; an inline body, which has no Card, by the canonical digest of its typed spec. Binding projection, runs, and dispatches store this identity so later Card changes never retarget admitted work.

oneOf.description: The canonical spec digest of an inline body.

OperatorDispatchState.description: Current state of one Operator dispatch in a Run GET response.

error.description: Last delivery error, when one occurred.

operator.description: The frozen Operator Card UID or inline-spec digest.

OperatorDispatchStatus.description: Delivery state of one Operator dispatch.

oneOf.description: Created by settlement and waiting for its first claim.
Claimed by the Operator worker under an unexpired lease.
A transient delivery failure is waiting for its next attempt.
Failed terminally or exhausted its attempts.

VerificationError.description: Structured, secret-free execution or delivery error.

VerificationExecutionStatus.description:
Execution state of one Verifier run.

Independent of the verdict: only `completed` has one, and it lives in the Bifrost result the run points at. `cancelled`, `timed_out`, and `errored` never carry a verdict or dispatch an Operator.

oneOf.description: Enqueued and waiting for its first claim.
Claimed by a runner under an unexpired lease.
A retryable failure is waiting for its next attempt.
Executed and produced an acknowledged result.
Failed terminally or exhausted its attempts.
